note: Good to know this month (under the map). Focus: travelling and getting around with kids (ferries, roads, transit, flights, travel gear), then outings. Only this month's news from official sources; summaries are our own words. Old standing policies (e.g. 2021 free transit for kids) don't belong here. 'until' = last day to show. Types: ferry, road, transit, flight, gear, free, health.

items.title: Ferry deals on Christmas Day and New Year's Day
items.summary: Saver fares on Fri Dec 25 and Fri Jan 1: from $49 one way for a car and driver between Metro Vancouver and Vancouver Island, and from $39 return to the Sunshine Coast. Book online ahead; space is limited.

items.title: Driving to the mountains? Winter tires are required
items.summary: Winter tires or chains are required on many BC highways, including the Sea-to-Sky to Whistler, until March 31 or April 30 depending on the route. Most Lower Mainland city roads are exempt. All-wheel drive alone doesn't count.

items.title: Free night at the Vancouver Art Gallery, Fri Dec 4
items.summary: Free for everyone 4–8 pm on the first Friday of the month. Kids and youth 18 and under are free any day. Reserve a spot ahead; walk-ins depend on space.

items.title: Holiday puppet show and sing-along at the library
items.summary: Frog and Toad puppet show, then a holiday sing-along at the Fraserview Branch, Wed Dec 16 and Fri Dec 18, 4–5 pm. Drop-in, all ages.

items.title: Before holiday trips: free flu shots for kids 6 months and up
items.summary: Book at getvaccinated.gov.bc.ca or call 1-833-838-2323. Kids getting a flu shot for the first time may need two doses, four weeks apart, so book early.
